paper_id: Li et al. - 2014 - Towards Network-level Efficiency for Cloud Storage Services
title: Towards Network-level Efficiency for Cloud Storage Services
motivation: 云存储同步流量巨大，给服务商和用户都带来财务负担，需量化流量使用效率
problem_framing: 定义TUE指标量化同步流量效率，通过trace和实验分析六种服务的流量开销来源
key_insight: 大量同步流量本质上是浪费的，通过精心设计的同步机制可有效避免或大幅降低
method_signature: trace测量+对照实验，测量创建/删除/修改等操作的流量TUE，跨PC/网页/移动端
evaluation_criteria: TUE（总同步流量/数据更新大小）作为核心指标，测量各服务的流量开销效率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 压缩与分块去重同时实现技术上困难，建议只实现压缩和全文去重；固定同步延迟在某些场景低效
evidence_for_taste: considerable portion of the data sync traffic is in a sense wasteful
can be effectively avoided or significantly reduced
implementing compression and block-level deduplication together is technically challenging
Surprisingly, users with relatively poor hardware or Internet access save on sync traffic
fixed sync deferments are inefficient in some scenarios
thinking_moves: 从财务痛点出发定义效率指标TUE，借鉴PUE的命名方式
通过trace发现77%是小文件，两 thirds可批量同步以节省开销
意外发现：网络差或硬件慢的用户反而节省流量，因更新自然被批处理
承认某些技术组合实现困难，建议务实的简化方案
cites_own_work: Li et al. 2013 - Efficient Batched Synchronization (UDS algorithm)
